summary.text: One of Penelope's suitors in Apollodorus' catalogue of the fifty-seven wooers from Dulichium — a namesake of Acarnan son of Alcmaeon, eponym of Acarnania.

story.text: Apollodorus names Acarnan among the suitors who devoured Odysseus' substance, listed after Ctesius and before Cycnus in the long company of Penelope's wooers.
